title: Dada's Apple Garden
about: Story A. Every line is said by its speaker in their own voice and shown in the bubble word for word ({shown|IPA} gives a sound). Recorded into the app by tools/voice/generate_voice.py --app as story_a_<id>. The art is in this folder (tools/stories/cut_art.py).

lines.text: Pencil! Pencil! Dada needs help. Come to the apple garden!
Oh no! The rain washed my shop sign away. And the market opens soon!
Don't worry, Dada. We will help!
First, we need apples. Tap the red apples on the tree!
Look around! Can you find more things that start with {A|ˈeɪ}? Tap them!
That's a bird. Bird starts with {B|bˈiː}. Try again!
Wonderful! Now let's go to the market!
Here is my shop. But look, the sign is empty!
Let's write {A|ˈeɪ} on the sign. {A|ˈeɪ} for apples!
Wow! {A|ˈeɪ} for apples. Now everyone can see it!
Now let's write {A|ˈeɪ} on the apple baskets too.
Hello! Can I have three apples, please?
Tap an apple to put it in Aunty's bag.
Thank you! Here you go. {A|ˈeɪ} for apple. Yum!
Thank you, my little friend! You saved my shop. This golden apple is for you!
{A|ˈeɪ} is for apple! Next time, let's visit the bakery!
Tap a red apple on the tree!
Look in the sky, and on the grass!
Tap an apple in the basket!
